name: Ridiculousness
description: Rob Dyrdek takes the funniest amateur internet videos and builds them into an episode of edgy, funny, and most importantly, timeless television.

videos.title: Top 10 Super Show
videos.overview: Rob counts down his top ten categories of the series in this "clip show of a clip show." Featuring Johnny Knoxville, Floyd Mayweather, Justin Bieber Quinton "Rampage" Jackson, Sara Jean Underwood, and more.

videos.title: Best of the Guest
videos.overview: Get ready for the height of Ridiculousness in an all-new "clip show within a clip show" featuring the absolute Best of the Guests from all three hilarious seasons!

videos.title: A Very Merry Ridiculousness
videos.overview: On a very special holiday episode of Ridiculousness, the one and only Santa Claus joins Rob as they break down hard-hitting “Jingle Bells,” enjoy hilarious “Holiday Memories” and witness some very lucky "Christmas Miracles."

videos.title: The Super Party
videos.overview: It’s not a party until someone films it and puts it on the internet. Rob Dyrdek takes us through the all-time greatest hard partying moments of categories.

videos.title: The Sports Spectacular
videos.overview: It’s an all out sportsfest as Rob Dyrdek revisits his favorite sports categories from past seasons of Ridiculousness.

videos.title: Love, Hugs, and Slams
videos.overview: Rob takes a look at Ridiculousness' most romantic moments — from overly amorous make-outs to the most passionate of slams.

videos.title: Family Style
videos.overview: Buckle up for a family-style journey through the greatest categories about moms, dads, kids, and all your loved ones.

videos.title: Grossest Episode Ever
videos.overview: Things get grosser than ever when Rob, Chanel and Steelo check out some talented "Ass Masters," avoid the "Boogie Knights" and discover the disgusting side of "Mother Birding."

videos.overview: Rob, Chanel, and Steelo swap places as Chanel teaches that CUTE KILLS, Steelo warns about DEATH CARTS and Rob shows how people get down with PPP.

videos.title: Summer Vacation
videos.overview: Rob, Chanel and Steelo celebrate summer vacation by getting "Sand Blasted," take a trip to "Painland" and party with "The Bang Gang."

videos.title: Big Black's Biggest & Best
videos.overview: A tribute to the late Christopher “Big Black” Boykin. A nostalgic look back at Big Black’s best on-screen moments from MTV’s hit series “Rob & Big” and “Fantasy Factory”.

videos.title: The Happy Everything Episode
videos.overview: Rob, Steelo, and Chanel celebrate the holiday season by fighting through BLACK AND BLUE FRIDAY, GETTIN' UGLY with Christmas sweaters, and spinning some HUMAN DREIDELS.
